component.name: ProgressBar
component.description: A horizontal bar that shows how much of a course the learner has completed.

useWhen: Showing how far a learner has progressed through a course on a CardHorizontal or CardVertical
Displaying completion percentage on a profile or dashboard summary

notFor.case: Using ProgressBar for loading spinners or indeterminate states
notFor.because: ProgressBar requires a known 0–100 value. Indeterminate loading needs a different pattern.
notFor.note: Use a spinner or skeleton component (not in scope for this library).

donts.case: Omitting the label prop when more than one ProgressBar can appear on a page (e.g. a list of course cards)
donts.because: role="progressbar" defaults aria-label to the generic "Progress", so screen reader users can't tell which item a given bar belongs to without also relying on nearby text.
donts.instead: Pass label describing what is progressing, e.g. `${title} progress` (see CardHorizontal), or pass aria-labelledby pointing at the visible title's id when the title is already rendered nearby (CardVertical.Progress).
